control_failures.control_label: provision and briefing of a competent fire watch
availability and testing of fixed fire protection

facts.hazard_release: fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation
facts.title: unplanned release of chemical energy at TK-7103

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control FIRE_WATCH_PROVISION: the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

Control FIXED_FIRE_SYSTEM_AVAILABILITY: the availability and testing of fixed fire protection had degraded below its design intent, and the learning team review classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Confirm at the next assurance activity that the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch on TK-7103, LT-7103 and PSV-7103 performs as designed.
response.sequence: Work was under way in mustering and rescuing, specifically deploying an emergency response team. TK-7103 (product storage tanks) is in service for export product storage. The task proceeded during an intrusive maintenance task while the provision and briefing of a competent fire watch was not in place. The chemical energy involved is held as hydrocarbon, and the recorded presentation was fire, toxic exposure, corrosive contact, detonation.
response.summary: On 25 September 2025 a high potential incident was recorded on TK-7103, LT-7103 and PSV-7103 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during an intrusive maintenance task; chemical energy held as hydrocarbon was not released.
